title: Large self-similar solutions of a convection--diffusion equation
summary: We construct self-similar solutions to a nonlinear convection--diffusion equation posed on the whole Euclidean space, for a class of homogeneous initial data. The corresponding self-similar profiles solve a nonlinear elliptic equation on $\mathbb{R}^N$. We obtain these profiles as limits of solutions to Dirichlet problems on bounded domains with truncated nonlinearities, using a priori estimates that are uniform with respect to both the domain size and the truncation level.
